title: bartlettina calderonii
intro: Bartlettina calderonii, commonly known as Mexican mint, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Mexican folk medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and fever, as well as treating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Bartlettina calderonii are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which can help in alleviating symptoms of colds, coughs, and other respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
